description: North Central Province - Removal from Office
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces the removal of named individuals (Mr. Darshana Anuradha Nanayakkara, Mr. I. M. Hettiarachchi, and Mr. I. M. M. B. Ilangasinghe) from their posts in the Road Development Authority. It mentions the Governor by name (Mahiepala Herath) but only provides basic titles ("Chairman" and "Member") without any detailed descriptions of their portfolio responsibilities or subject matter duties. This fits the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2) as it focuses exclusively on government personnel changes without detailing their specific responsibilities.
